bends.note: Harrison starts to curve toward the SE here: about 10 deg below east to the west, about 29 deg at Koebel, about 50 deg at Patterson
mid-curve point between Koebel and Patterson
McLean runs due north-south above here and turns SSW (about 27 deg off vertical) below; Division Street carries on due south from the east half

notes: McLean Avenue: west line x~830-841 (edge of the flour-mill and text blocks in the sheet-223 margin), east line x~1452-1463, so the centre is ~1141-1152 (the water pipe runs ~20 px east of centre). Two alleys meet McLean only ~86 px apart: Harvis Alley from the east (y~1254) and, from the west, a 12 ft gap between the margin blocks at y~1340 which is the Ernst Alley of sheet 223 (its name is not printed here). The alley labelled ERNST / ALLEY on this sheet (20 ft) is ~540 px further south (y~1882) and runs from McLean across Turner Alley to Winchell. Division Street (west line x~1142-1150, east line = McLean east line ~1450, centre ~1296-1300) forks off the McLean bend; as on sheet 223 the bend point is used for Division/McLean. Barnard Street and Western Avenue come in from the sheet-223 margin: Barnard ends at McLean; Western crosses McLean (its NE line resumes at the 2104/2108 corner SE of McLean) and continues SE across Bank, so both are crosses. Western/McLean is very close to the binding (x~146). Brighton (named on sheet 225, ~10-12 ft) leaves Patterson's east side toward the ESE into sheet 225. Koebel, Patterson and Turner Alley lean slightly like the page (Koebel centre 5261 at Harrison, 5238 at Bank; Patterson 6106 -> 6073). Winchell crosses Bank (blocks south of Bank on both sides); Koebel, Patterson, Turner Alley and Division end at Bank. The 'BRIDGE 2nd' links over Koebel are not streets.
